data.title: Binance Pay, DK Bank and Tether Sign MOU to Expand Stablecoin Payments to Merchants Across Bhutan, Starting with USD₮
data.description:
Binance Pay, DK Bank and Tether Sign MOU to Expand Stablecoin Payments to Merchants Across Bhutan, Starting with USD₮

Binance Pay, DK Bank and Tether Sign MOU to Expand Stablecoin Payments to Merchants Across Bhutan, Starting with USD₮

PR Newswire

BANGKOK, Nov. 28, 2026

Signed at Binance Blockchain Week 2026, the initiative builds on Bhutan's national crypto payment network and plans incentives to help merchants adopt stablecoin payments

BANGKOK, Nov. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Binance Pay, DK Bank, Gelephu Mindfulness City's official bank, and Tether today signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) to bring stablecoin payments to merchants across Bhutan, starting with USD₮. The MOU was signed at Binance Blockchain Week Bangkok 2026 by Thomas Gregory, Vice President of Payments & Fiat at Binance; Ugyen Tenzin, Chief Executive Officer of DK Bank; and Tether.

The MOU builds on the payment network Binance Pay and DK Bank launched in May 2025, when Bhutan became the first country to introduce a national-level crypto payment system for tourism. Subject to eligibility requirements, users can pay participating merchants with supported digital assets, and merchants receive Bhutanese ngultrum. More than 3,700 merchants now accept payments through the system, from hotels and airlines to roadside vendors.

Under the MOU, the parties will work to promote stablecoin payments for merchants on this network.

To encourage participation, eligible users can receive a 5% rebate on qualifying transactions, capped at US$5 per transaction. Eligibility criteria and final terms are subject to agreement.

"Bhutan has shown that crypto payments can work at a national level," said Thomas Gregory, VP of Payments & Fiat, Binance. "With Tether and DK Bank, we want to make stablecoins and crypto the easier way to pay in Bhutan, and make accepting it worth it for every merchant."

"Since 2025, Bhutanese merchants have shown growing interest in accepting digital payments," said Ugyen Tenzin, CEO of DK Bank. "This initiative further enhances their ability to accept payments from international customers, and merchants can benefit from the reach of digital payment networks while continuing to receive their payments entirely in local currency."

The MOU is non-binding. Implementation, including the launch date and rebate terms, remains subject to final agreement between the parties.

About Binance Pay: Binance Pay is a secure, seamless, and borderless payment feature on Binance. It enables users and merchants to pay with fiat or crypto, and send and receive cryptocurrencies worldwide, all without gas fees. Supporting more than 300 cryptocurrencies and accepted by over 21 million merchants globally, Binance Pay helps connect digital assets with everyday commerce. Since its launch in 2021, Binance Pay has processed more than $321 billion in transaction volume.

About DK Bank:  Established in 2021, DK Bank is Gelephu Mindfulness City's official bank, serving individuals and corporations within the Gelephu Mindfulness City (GMC) and across the Kingdom. With a focus on innovation, cross-border payments, and emerging financial technologies, DK Bank is building an integrated financial ecosystem that bridges traditional banking with Web3 finance. For more information, visit https://www.dk.bt.

About Tether and USD₮:  Tether is a pioneer in stablecoin technology. It aims to revolutionize the global financial landscape and provide accessible, secure, and efficient financial, communication, and energy infrastructure that helps enhance security and efficiency. Tether enables greater financial inclusion and communication resilience, fosters economic growth, and empowers individuals and businesses.

As the creator of the industry's largest, most transparent, and liquid stablecoin, Tether is dedicated to building a sustainable and resilient infrastructure for the benefit of underserved communities. By leveraging cutting-edge blockchain and peer-to-peer technology, it is committed to bridging the gap between traditional financial systems and the potential of decentralized finance.

data.title: Binance Secures In-Principle Approval in Gelephu Mindfulness City, Plans Asia Hub in Bhutan
data.description:
Binance Secures In-Principle Approval in Gelephu Mindfulness City, Plans Asia Hub in Bhutan

Binance Secures In-Principle Approval in Gelephu Mindfulness City, Plans Asia Hub in Bhutan

PR Newswire

BANGKOK, Nov. 28, 2026

The regulatory milestone marks a major step toward Binance establishing an Asia hub in Gelephu Mindfulness City, alongside commitments to create jobs and strengthen Bhutan's digital-asset capabilities

BANGKOK, Nov. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Binance, the leading global financial platform powered by blockchain, has received in-principle approval (IPA) from the Gelephu Central Bank (GCB) to establish regulated digital-asset operations in Gelephu Mindfulness City (GMC), Bhutan.

The milestone was marked at Binance Blockchain Week 2026, where Binance and GMC signed a cooperation agreement setting out their broader partnership and plans for GMC to become an Asia hub for Binance users. The IPA is an important milestone in a broader, ongoing effort to expand access and build out the ecosystem locally. Binance has been deepening its presence in Bhutan since launching a national crypto-powered tourism payment system in 2025. As the partnership progresses, Binance will continue building out the local digital-asset ecosystem.

Binance will now work with GCB to fulfil the conditions attached to the IPA and complete the remaining regulatory requirements before receiving its full licence.

The partnership goes beyond licensing. Binance plans to establish a substantive operational presence in Bhutan, creating employment opportunities while investing in the development of talent and digital-asset capabilities.

As part of the partnership, Binance will work with GMC to build capabilities and upskill the talent pool, including through employment, training, knowledge sharing and collaboration across areas such as digital assets, compliance and operations. The parties also intend to explore opportunities to develop GMC as a regional centre of excellence, supporting Binance's broader operations in Asia while building expertise and capabilities within GMC.

Speaking on this milestone, Jigdrel Singay, Board Director of Gelephu Mindfulness City, said "Binance choosing Gelephu Mindfulness City as a base for its Asia operations is an important milestone for what we are building in Bhutan. Our ambition is not simply to attract global companies to establish an entity here. We want them to build real operations, create meaningful jobs, develop talent and transfer capabilities that remain in the country over the long term.

"The in-principle approval is an important first step, and we look forward to working closely with Binance and GCB as Binance completes the remaining regulatory requirements and builds its presence in GMC," Singay added.

SB Seker Head of APAC, Binance said, "Establishing an Asia hub in Gelephu Mindfulness City is a strategic decision that reflects Binance's commitment to operating within clear, progressive regulatory frameworks. The IPA from GCB is an important validation of GMC's approach to digital asset regulation, one that protects users while enabling innovation."

"GMC's vision of combining traditional values with cutting-edge technology, powered by renewable energy, makes it an ideal location for Binance's regional center of excellence. We are committed to making this partnership a model for responsible growth in the digital asset sector," added Seker.

The partnership forms part of GMC's broader ambition to establish Bhutan as a trusted and internationally connected hub for digital assets and financial innovation, combining a clear regulatory framework with a long-term focus on developing local talent and institutional capabilities.

The granting of the IPA does not constitute a full licence. Binance must satisfy the conditions specified by GCB and complete the remaining regulatory requirements before the relevant regulated activities may commence.

About Gelephu Mindfulness City: The Gelephu Mindfulness City Special Administrative Region is a visionary initiative creating a world-class economic hub in southern Bhutan, centered on mindfulness, sustainability, and innovation. The SAR integrates traditional Bhutanese values with globally recognized legal frameworks, cutting-edge design and technology, while harnessing the Kingdom's abundant renewable energy resources to serve as a global exemplar of holistic development. For more information, visit www.gmc.bt.

About Binance: Binance is a leading global financial platform, combining advanced technology and AI to connect users and institutions with the next generation of finance. Trusted by more than 300 million users across 100+ countries, Binance brings together a broad range of financial products and services, connecting digital assets with traditional financial markets through one integrated platform. Beyond financial services, its ecosystem extends to education, research, social impact, institutional solutions and Web3 innovation. Powered by industry-leading technology, advanced AI capabilities, deep liquidity, robust security and a commitment to compliance, Binance is building an inclusive global financial ecosystem to realise its vision of increasing the freedom of money for people around the world. For more information, visit: https://www.binance.com

data.title: Beisen Holding announced its interim results for fiscal year 2027: AI contract value increased by 390.3% year on year, and adjusted net profit increased by 72.1%
data.description:
BEIJING, Nov. 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Beisen Holding Limited (“Beisen Holding” or the “Company”, stock code: 9669.HK) is pleased to announce the unaudited consolidated results of the Company and its subsidiaries (collectively, the “Group”) for the six months ended September 30, 2026 (the “Reporting Period”). During the Reporting Period, AI revenue exceeded RMB57 million, representing year on year growth of approximately 465%, while the number of AI customers reached 2,504, up187.5% year on year. Beisen continued to lead the industry in AI monetization. Total revenue increased steadily to approximately RMB593.3 million, up 15.0% year on year, and revenue from cloud-based HCM solutions was approximately RMB478.9 million, up 15.7% year on year. Core HCM solution ARR increased 25.5% year on year and accounted for 61.2% of total ARR. Beisen achieved a historic breakthrough in profitability, with its net profit margin improving to 1.8%, marking its first turnaround since listing; adjusted net profit increased 72.1% year on year, while the adjusted net profit margin reached 5.7%, up 2 percentage points year on year; operating quality also continued to improve, with subscription revenue retention rate reaching 108%, up 3 percentage points year on year.

AI monetization is leading the industry by a significant margin, with contract value increasing nearly fourfold year on year.

During the reporting period, Beisen officially transformed into an AI application company in the HR field. Simultaneously, the company launched Mavens, a one-stop AI HR expert platform, offering over 15 AI HR experts comprehensively covering six core scenarios: strategic operations, talent acquisition, management training, talent development, training and learning, and employee services. Mavens leverages Beisen's proprietary vertical-domain SenGPT model and SenClaw Agent technology, integrating Beisen's over 20 years of HR expertise in People Science, pioneering a new collaborative paradigm of "human HR + digital HR": human HR focuses on understanding the business, setting standards, and making judgments, while digital HR efficiently executes tasks, reshaping the way enterprises manage human resources. Specifically, the AI applications on the Mavens platform fall into two categories: AI Assistants and AI Experts. The first category comprises AI Assistants, which streamline transactional HR tasks, handling onboarding reviews, HR Q&A, etc. Routine employee lifecycle workflows across onboarding, transfers, transitions and offboarding can be delegated to AI Assistants. In contrast, the second category AI experts are capable of providing independent professional judgment, delivering talent analysis, strategic insights, and providing talent appointment recommendations, drawing on the expertise of a seasoned HR veteran in talent acquisition, deployment, development, and retention. This second tier of AI Experts defines Beisen’s core competitive differentiation in the HR application field.

During the reporting period, Beisen led the industry in AI monetization by a wide margin. AI contract value exceeded RMB132 million, representing a nearly fourfold year on year increase. The number of AI customers under contract reached 2,504, up 187.5% year on year. New contract value for the three flagship AI Agents - AI Interviewer, AI Leadership Coach, and AI Sales Coach increased by 132% year on year, with net dollar retention (NDR) exceeding 200%. As customers expanded both the breadth and depth of their usage, Beisen’s AI-native applications achieved a scalable flywheel effect. New landmark enterprise customers such as Hilton, Naura Technology, Longsys, GAC Toyota, and Chia Tai Tianqing were signed during the reporting period, fully validating the market recognition and competitiveness of its products. In addition, contract value for the Mavens AI upgraded edition surged by 977% year on year to exceed RMB88.53 million, accounting for 67% of total AI contract value in the first half of the fiscal year. The number of customers under contract increased by 301% year on year to 1,758. The upgraded AI edition has become a driving force for both existing customer upsells and new customer acquisition. This momentum is underpinned by the strong competitiveness of Beisen AI products, as well as rising customer willingness to pay for high-value AI solutions.

Beisen's unique advantages and barriers

Beisen's differentiated position in the AI HR field stems from three difficult-to-replicate composite capabilities. First, Beisen has deep People Science expertise. With more than 20 years of practical experience in talent assessment and management, as well as nearly 300 psychology experts, Beisen has accumulated hundreds of millions of real-world assessment samples and developed proprietary expertise in competency, assessment and development methodologies. Second, Beisen has an integrated HR SaaS business and data foundation. Serving over 6,000 medium-to-large enterprises, Beisen has accumulated deep domain knowledge and data across recruitment, assessment, HR administration, time and attendance, payroll, performance and learning. Beisen is the only HR professional company that simultaneously possesses both "consulting" and "software" genes. Third, Beisen has built a professional team of more than 300 forward-deployed engineers to work with clients' business teams, deeply customizing job models and role profiles. This allows AI experts on the Mavens platform to develop within the clients' unique personnel logic, organizational language, and business scenarios, truly transforming "Beisen's AI" into "the clients' AI."

Deepened execution of Core HCM large enterprise strategy drives strong 25.5% ARR growth

Core HCM serves as the cornerstone of Beisen's integrated strategy and the primary gateway for full-lifecycle employee management. During the reporting period, Beisen accurately grasped the refined management needs of large groups with tens of thousands of employees, high-end manufacturing enterprises, and chain retailers, and comprehensively upgraded its product matrix: the AI scheduling expert has more than 100 mature preconfigured rules built in, driving scheduling from experience-based judgment to rule-driven automations; AI versions of HR, leave and attendance, and payroll were launched simultaneously; and the upgraded AI employee assistant 3.0 has reduced HR teams’ inquiry workloads by more than 80%.

During the reporting period, Core HCM integrated ARR reached RMB690 million, a year-on-year increase of 25.5%; the number of customers reached 2,989, a year-on-year increase of 19.9%; the customer retention rate was 95%, and the revenue retention rate was 115%. This success was attributed to the continued strengthening of the overall competitiveness of Beisen's products, as well as the explosive growth of Beisen’s AI products, which led to stronger customer retention and higher average revenue per customer. During the reporting period, Beisen signed new contracts with several industry leaders, including ZXMOTO, Siemens (China), and Domino's (China).

In the future, Beisen will continue to improve the capabilities and collaboration of its 15 AI HR experts, helping clients more effectively train, utilize, and manage digital HR staff. Simultaneously, it will actively leverage AI agents and intelligent office portals such as Work Buddy, Doubao Work, and Qianwen Office to expand into new clients and scenarios. Beisen will continue to increase investment in FDE (Forward-Deployed Engineers) to drive the application of AI into clients' business scenarios. It will upgrade and iterate its self-developed SenGPT model and self-developed SenClaw technology foundation, increasing investment in AI product development and technology; it will continue to strengthen content research in areas such as talent assessment and training, integrating high-quality content resources to enhance its professional accumulation and content barriers in talent science.

About Beisen:

Founded in 2002, Beisen is the first publicly listed HR SaaS company in China (9669.HK), and has maintained the number one market share in China's HCM SaaS market for 10 consecutive years (IDC data). In 2026, Beisen underwent a comprehensive strategic upgrade to become an AI application company, launching Mavens, China's first one-stop AI HR expert platform, and introducing over 15 AI HR experts to create a new generation of Agentic HR systems.

Leveraging its self-developed PaaS platform, Beisen has created an industry-leading integrated HR SaaS that covers all scenarios including recruitment, assessment, human resources, leave and attendance, payroll, performance, succession, and learning, serving over 6,000 medium and large-sized clients (including 70% of Fortune China 500 companies).

data.title: BEACN Announces Financial Results for the Third Quarter of 2026
data.description:
VICTORIA, BC / ACCESS Newswire / November 27, 2026 / BEACN Wizardry & Magic Inc. (TSXV:BECN) ("BEACN" or the "Company") announces its Q3 financial statements and accompanying MD&A have been filed. In the nine months ended September 30, 2026, BEACN realized a 37% decrease in revenue and a 33% decrease in gross profits when compared to the same period last year. The decrease in revenue was due to lack of inventory supply, and disruption in EU Amazon sales. Gross margin increased to 45% in Q1 to Q3 2026 (2025 - 42%) due to channel mix and price increases.

"Restoring sales rates from inventory stock outs is an ongoing effort and delays in bringing BEACN Headset continued to be a challenge in the last quarter. We're excited to have BEACN Headset shipping in US and Canada as of November," says BEACN CEO, Kevin Alexander.

Further information is available from the Company's financial statements for the period ending on June 30, 2026, on SEDAR at www.sedar.com.

About BEACN

BEACN (TSXV:BECN), a Victoria BC based consumer electronics company, develops innovative audio equipment, peripherals and technology for gamers, live streamers, and content creators. BEACN is committed to delivering premium products that enable everyone to produce studio-quality content. BEACN's award-winning product ecosystem includes BEACN Mic, BEACN Studio, BEACN Mix and BEACN Mix Create. BEACN is listed on the TSXV under the symbol BECN.

data.title: DPC Dash - Domino's Pizza China Wins Sixth Seven-Star Award, Underscoring Its Quality Control Advantage and Sustainable Operating Efficiency as It Expands
data.description:
DPC Dash - Domino's Pizza China Wins Sixth Seven-Star Award, Underscoring Its Quality Control Advantage and Sustainable Operating Efficiency as It Expands

DPC Dash - Domino's Pizza China Wins Sixth Seven-Star Award, Underscoring Its Quality Control Advantage and Sustainable Operating Efficiency as It Expands

PR Newswire

HONG KONG, Nov. 27, 2026

HONG KONG, Nov. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- DPC Dash – Domino's Pizza China ("DPC Dash" or the "Company") (1405.HK), Domino's Pizza's exclusive master franchisee in the Chinese Mainland, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of China, and the Macau Special Administrative Region of China, received its sixth Seven-Star Award at the 15th Annual Seven-Star Awards for Outstanding Contributions in Food Safety & Public Health, held in Shanghai on November 26. Winning the award six years in a row, while rapidly expanding its store network, reflects DPC Dash's sustained work on food safety governance, supply chain standardization and measurable ESG practices. For investors, the award provides independent recognition of the Company's ability to maintain quality controls and operational consistency as it scales.

Strong food safety and quality governance gives DPC Dash a competitive advantage, helping protect its brand and replicate its store operating model as it expands rapidly. As of September 30, 2026, the Company operated 1,634 stores across 87 cities in the Chinese Mainland, up 24% from the end of 2025, and its fully company-operated model gives it direct oversight across the network. The Company applies a rigorous farm-to-table food safety framework, from ingredient sourcing to in-store customer service, using standardized procedures, digital controls and training for all employees. These measures help manage operational and reputational risks, maintain product consistency and encourage repeat visits as DPC Dash enters new cities and expands in existing markets.

DPC Dash invests in centralized supply chain infrastructure ahead of store expansion to maintain consistent quality across regions and capture economies of scale. By the end of 2025, all (100%) of the Company's central kitchens then in operation had passed third-party audits under the internationally recognized FSSC 22000 food safety management system certification scheme, aligning with the quality and compliance standards that international institutions look for. On August 21, 2026, DPC Dash opened its fourth supply chain center in Wuhan, which combines production, warehousing and distribution and can support more than 200 stores. An integrated digital platform manages procurement, warehousing and distribution, and monitors cold-chain shipments around the clock from production to store delivery. As store density increases in the region, the hub helps make order fulfillment across regions more efficient and improve the supply chain cost structure, while supporting consistent quality standards in new and expanding markets. This supports the Company's nationwide expansion over the medium to long term.

DPC Dash builds sustainability into its efforts to lower costs and improve efficiency across its stores and supply chain. Its priorities include using energy and resources more efficiently, reducing food waste and adopting sustainable packaging. In its 2025 Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) Report, the Company disclosed that sustainable packaging accounted for 85.13% of packaging used. All snack boxes and pizza trays are made from recyclable materials, and delivery and dine-in cutlery is made from biodegradable materials. The Company also fits store ovens with energy-saving shields that recover waste heat. This reduces heat loss, directly improves store-level energy efficiency and lowers the Company's environmental footprint, supporting long-term profitability and sustainable growth.

Initiated by the Seven-Star Convention Alliance, the Seven-Star Awards are an established industry benchmark promoting food safety, public health and sustainable development. The awards assess companies across seven criteria: organizational structure, supply chain management, production standards, corporate integrity, health advocacy, innovation leadership and sustainable development. Looking ahead, DPC Dash will continue to strengthen food safety governance and its centralized supply chain as it expands its store network nationwide, focusing on consistent product quality, operational efficiency and transparent ESG disclosure. The Company will also continue to combine global product ideas with Chinese consumers' preferences to broaden its localized pizza menu, drive long-term growth and create sustainable long-term value for shareholders.

About DPC Dash – Domino's Pizza China

DPC Dash is Domino's Pizza's exclusive master franchisee in the Chinese Mainland, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of China and the Macau Special Administrative Region of China. Domino's Pizza, Inc., DPC Dash's global franchisor, is one of the most widely-recognized global consumer brands and the world's largest pizza company. Led by a seasoned and visionary management team, DPC Dash is a market leader that differentiates from competitors with, among others, a continually innovated and localized pizza-focused menu, unique expertise and leadership in delivery, technology focus and scalable and replicable store economic model. As of September 30, 2026, DPC Dash operated 1,634 stores in 87 cities in the Chinese Mainland.

data.title: KIND Voluntarily Recalls One Variety of Granola for Potential Undeclared Peanut Allergen
data.description:
KIND Voluntarily Recalls One Variety of Granola for Potential Undeclared Peanut Allergen

KIND Voluntarily Recalls One Variety of Granola for Potential Undeclared Peanut Allergen

PR Newswire

CHICAGO, Nov. 27, 2026

CHICAGO, Nov. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- KIND is voluntarily recalling its Oats & Honey with Toasted Coconut Granola in the U.S. because it may contain undeclared peanuts. Individuals with an allergy or severe sensitivity to peanuts are at risk of experiencing serious or life‑threatening allergic reactions if they consume this product.

The product was distributed through retailers nationwide between 9/29/2026 and 11/16/2026. The Oats & Honey with Toasted Coconut Granola is sold in 17-ounce yellow and black packaging. The recall applies to product with the following identifiers:

  • Lot code CS26245L7, CS26246L7 and CS26247L7
  • Best buy date of September 2, 2027, September 3, 2027, and September 4, 2027

The recall applies only to Oat & Honey with Toasted Coconut Granola produced over these three days; granola produced on other dates is not impacted. No other KIND products are affected by this recall.

One consumer complaint of an allergic reaction has been received to date.

Consumers with peanut allergies or other concerns with exposure to peanuts should not eat the impacted Granola. Consumers are instead urged to discard the product and contact KIND Consumer Care at customerservice@kindsnacks.com.

ABOUT MARS, INCORPORATED
Mars, Incorporated is driven by the belief that the world we want tomorrow starts with how we do business today. Based on combined Mars and Kellanova 2025 net sales, we are now a $65bn+ family-owned business, with a diverse portfolio of quality snacking and food products that delight millions of people every day, and leading pet care products and veterinary services that support pets all around the world. We produce some of the world's best-loved brands including ROYAL CANIN®, PEDIGREE®, WHISKAS®, CESAR®, M&M'S®, SNICKERS®, EXTRA®, Pringles®, Cheez-It®, and BEN'S ORIGINAL™. Our international networks of pet hospitals, including BANFIELD™, BLUEPEARL™, VCA™ and ANICURA™ span preventive, general, specialty, and emergency veterinary care, and our global veterinary diagnostics business ANTECH® offers breakthrough capabilities in pet diagnostics. The Mars Five Principles — Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom — inspire our approximately 170,000 Associates to act every day to help create a better world for people, pets and the planet.

data.title: SSF Home Group Delivers RM36.08 Million Revenue in Q1 FYE2027
data.description:
KUALA LUMPUR, MY / ACCESS Newswire / November 27, 2026 / SSF Home Group Berhad ("SSF" or the "Group"), a well-known retailer in furniture, home décor, and home living products, today announced its financial results for the first quarter ended 30 September 2026 ("Q1 FYE2027"), recording revenue of RM36.08 million, gross profit ("GP") of RM19.59 million, profit before tax ("PBT") of RM0.75 million and profit after tax ("PAT") of RM0.55 million. The Group recorded a GP margin of 54.3%, while basic earnings per share stood at 0.07 sen.

SSFHOME Flagship Garden Outlet

Following the change in the Group's financial year-end from 30 April to 30 June, no comparative figures are presented for the corresponding quarter of the preceding year.

On a quarter-on-quarter ("QoQ") basis, the Group recorded revenue of RM36.08 million compared with RM25.65 million in the immediate preceding quarter. However, the reported figures are not directly comparable as the current quarter covers three months, while the preceding quarter covered only two months. PBT moderated from RM1.96 million to RM0.75 million, mainly attributable to the higher GP margin recorded in the preceding quarter following a reversal of inventories written down.

The Group maintained a sound financial position as at 30 September 2026, with cash and short-term deposits and short-term investments amounting to a combined RM74.20 million, with no outstanding bank borrowings. The Group also generated positive net operating cash flow of RM4.19 million during the quarter. In line with its commitment to delivering shareholder value, SSF paid a single-tier interim dividend of 0.5 sen per ordinary share, amounting to RM4.00 million, on 30 September 2026.

Mr. Lok Kok Khong, Executive Director of SSF Home Group Berhad commented, "As we embark on our next phase of growth, our focus remains on expanding our retail presence while enhancing the productivity and operational efficiency of our existing network. Despite the prevailing challenges in the retail environment, we remain committed to our ‘New Style, Big Value' proposition, offering stylish, practical and affordable home living solutions through refreshed store formats, strategic pricing and continuous product innovation."

He added, "Our recent proposed acquisition of industrial land in Pulau Indah, Selangor, for RM42.47 million also forms part of our long-term growth strategy. By developing our own warehouse and distribution facilities, we aim to enhance operational efficiency and scalability, strengthen our asset base and reduce our exposure to rising rental costs over time. This investment is expected to complement our ongoing retail expansion and better position the Group for future growth."

Earlier today, SSF also held its Fourth Annual General Meeting ("4th AGM"), during which the Group shared updates on its financial performance, operational developments and future expansion plans with shareholders. Following the opening of new outlets in Jerantut and Mega Square, Kuantan, between August and October 2026, the Group is scheduled to open its latest outlet in Ayer Keroh, Melaka, today.

Looking ahead, the Group remains cautiously optimistic about its prospects despite external headwinds, including rising production and logistics costs, inflationary pressures and geopolitical uncertainties. SSF will continue to strengthen its market presence through strategic outlet expansion, value-for-money offerings, cost efficiency initiatives and resilient supply chain partnerships, while maintaining a disciplined approach towards inventory and capital management.

###

ABOUT SSF HOME GROUP BERHAD

SSF Home Group Berhad is a leading Malaysian home furnishing retailer specialising in furniture, home décor, and living products. Our comprehensive offerings are accessible both in-store and online, catering to diverse tastes and preferences, transforming houses into cherished homes. With more than 40 retail outlets nationwide, SSF is committed to enhancing living standards by offering affordable, high-quality products that foster comfort and creativity in every dwelling.

For more information about SSF Home Group Berhad, please visit their corporate website http://ssf.com.my or e-commerce website http://ssfhome.com.

data.title: SDLG Group Holds Mining Equipment New Product Launch in Shanghai
data.description:
SDLG Group Holds Mining Equipment New Product Launch in Shanghai

SDLG Group Holds Mining Equipment New Product Launch in Shanghai

PR Newswire

SHANGHAI, Nov. 27, 2026

Seven new machines expand the group's integrated mining solutions portfolio

SHANGHAI, Nov. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- On November 24, 2026, SDLG Group unveiled seven new machines, including three wheel loaders, a mining hydrostatic dozer, a mining excavator and two hybrid haul trucks. The launch strengthens the group's integrated mining solutions across loading, excavation, drilling, hauling, dozing, compaction and grading.

The new lineup reflects SDLG Group's focus on new energy technologies, larger-capacity equipment and intelligent systems to improve productivity and energy efficiency:

  • L959K – All-new-generation K-series wheel loader
  • L9160KHB – The 16-ton class hybrid wheel loader
  • L958HEV – Unmanned intelligent wheel loader
  • D82H – Mining hydrostatic dozer
  • ME200 – Mining excavator
  • VTH150 – Hybrid electric-wheel haul truck
  • RTH186 – High-capacity electric haul truck

Selected models also feature drive-by-wire interfaces for seamless upgrades to autonomous operation.

This concentrated showcase features SDLG Group's star‑product lineup. Anchored in its full product matrix, our industry‑leading mining solutions span loading, excavating, drilling, hauling, compacting, grading and dozing. With multi-energy, manned/unmanned capabilities for open-pit and underground mines, we shift from single-machine excellence to full-chain optimization, lifting mine output and cutting total cost of ownership. It's the core rationale behind seven new products' launch.

Speaking at the event, Wang Zhizhong, Honorary Chairman of SDLG Group, highlighted the complexity of mining operations, which puts equipment quality, technology, service standards and problem-solving capabilities to the test. These principles underpin the group's newly unveiled "ONE SDLG" brand strategy, which emphasizes product excellence, intelligent innovation, full-lifecycle support and industry-wide collaboration.

SDLG Group leads China's wheel loader market as well as global mining truck sales, while ranking among the industry leaders in excavator sales. The group had maintained a strategic partnership with Volvo for 19 years. Drawing on this partnership, it empowers the group with core advantages to compete on equal footing with global-leading enterprises. On the service side, it is strengthening its local service network to provide timely, reliable support to customers worldwide.

Raúl Siucho Dextre, Chairman of the board of Peru's San Martín, shared his company's experience with LGMG's mining excavators and hybrid haul trucks, which have been used in continuous heavy-load operations at Shougang's high-altitude iron ore project in Peru since 2025.

Siucho Dextre praised the hybrid haul trucks for their energy efficiency and reduced emissions. Reliable equipment and responsive maintenance support have helped maximize uptime and productivity. He also looked forward to further product improvements tailored to high-altitude, heavy-load mining conditions.

SDLG Group now operates four overseas manufacturing bases, more than 80 overseas subsidiaries, with business operations spanning over 140 countries and regions. The group is moving beyond equipment supply to become a long-term partner offering integrated mining solutions. With its long-standing commitment to "Forge a Renowned Brand, Build a Century Legacy," the group will continue to work with global partners to advance efficient, intelligent and lower-carbon mining operations and expand the global reach of China's mining equipment industry.

data.title: First Citizens Bank Enters into Whole Bank Purchase of United Fidelity Bank, fsb
data.description:
First Citizens Bank Enters into Whole Bank Purchase of United Fidelity Bank, fsb

First Citizens Bank Enters into Whole Bank Purchase of United Fidelity Bank, fsb

PR Newswire

RALEIGH, N.C., Nov. 27, 2026

Acquisition strengthens First Citizens' competitive position and supports sustainable value creation 
for stakeholders

RALEIGH, N.C., Nov. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- First-Citizens Bank & Trust Company ("First Citizens Bank"), the wholly owned banking subsidiary of First Citizens BancShares, Inc. ("BancShares") (Nasdaq: FCNCA), announced today that it entered into an agreement with the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (the "FDIC") to purchase out of FDIC receivership substantially all loans and certain other assets, and assume all customer deposits (other than certain brokered deposits and other excluded accounts) and certain other liabilities of United Fidelity Bank, fsb ("UFB"), headquartered in Evansville, Ind.

In connection with the purchase, First Citizens Bank will acquire 20 former UFB branches in Indiana, Illinois, Colorado and Florida, and two branches in the U.S. Virgin Islands operating as Bank of St. Croix, a division of United Fidelity Bank. The agreement also includes UFB's subsidiaries, including Pedcor Homes Corporation real estate development and management subsidiary. The transaction is structured as a whole bank purchase, and First Citizens Bank was selected to complete this transaction through a competitive bidding process.

First Citizens Bank Chairman and CEO Frank B. Holding, Jr. said: "For more than 125 years, First Citizens has demonstrated a consistent commitment to financial strength, exceptional service and disciplined growth. We believe this transaction is both financially and strategically compelling, and we look forward to welcoming our new customers, earning their trust and positioning our company for continued success."

Under the agreement, First Citizens Bank will assume assets of $5.9 billion, deposits of $4.5 billion and loans of $3.1 billion, based on UFB's balances as of September 30, 2026. These amounts are estimates and remain subject to adjustment based on the final closing date balance sheet of UFB and the post-closing settlement process with the FDIC. First Citizens Bank's winning bid provided for an asset discount of approximately $2.6 billion and no deposit premium.

Starting Saturday, November 28, 2026, former UFB and Bank of St. Croix branches will operate as a division of First Citizens Bank. Locations with Saturday hours will be open regularly, and all branches will be open normal business hours on Monday, November 30, 2026.

Customers will be able to continue to access their accounts as they do today with no immediate change to their current accounts. A conversion to First Citizens Bank's operations and systems will take place at a later date.

ABOUT FIRST CITIZENS BANK
First Citizens Bank is a top 20 U.S. financial institution focused on helping consumers, businesses and entrepreneurs build lasting financial security. Headquartered in Raleigh, N.C., First Citizens Bank combines the strength and sophistication of a large bank with the personal attention and agility of a relationship-driven partner. Built over more than 125 years, the bank offers deep industry expertise, tailored financial solutions and specialized banking capabilities delivered at scale nationwide. From startups to international corporations, and personal banking to wealth management, First Citizens Bank supports its clients' ambitions at every stage of their financial journey. Parent company First Citizens BancShares, Inc. (NASDAQ: FCNCA) is a Fortune 500 company with more than $225 billion in assets. Learn more at firstcitizens.com.
